request_summary.prompt_prefix: Write a professional summary about the candidate.  CANDIDATE SKILL AREAS: Backend, Platform  CANDIDATE ACHIEVEMENTS (the only achievements you may reference):

response: {"summary":"4+ years of experience in Backend and Platform engineering, with a track record of scaling systems and driving architectural improvements. Rebuilt an ingestion pipeline to handle ten times the daily volume, led the migration of a billing service off a shared database, and cut p95 checkout latency from 900ms to 210ms. Delivered end-to-end platform services including a customer portal, a client reporting service, automated reconciliation jobs, schema versioning across six downstream consumers, and a deployment pipeline that remained in use for three years."}
